newsitem.title: USA: Templeton sees big U.S. bear market coming.
newsitem.headline: Templeton sees big U.S. bear market coming.

text.p: Renowned investor-turned-philosopher and philanthropist Sir John Templeton told a group of investors to be prepared for the biggest bear market in U.S. stocks since the Great Depression.

"The market will likely drop as much as 40 percent -- or more -- in the future. But if you have the strength, determination and money to live through it, you will come out well," the 84-year-old retired global investment pioneer told a group of investors in a speech late Thursday.

Templeton, who gave no more specific time frame for his prediction, was the keynote speaker at a regional stock market symposium. He said he did not think that any such crash, though big, would rival that of the Wall Street Crash of 1929.
He suggested that government bonds were a potential safe haven.
"Government bonds are a good deal for the first time in years and could be a bonanza if interest rates drop," he said.
